tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The warm grey canvas behind the phone, sheets and the kit's own pages.

tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: App screen background, under every card.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Every card, sheet, bubble and the floating nav.

tokens.name: card-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: unselected chips, inputs, the seat map aisle, stepper buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows inside a card. Never around a card: cards separate by shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, body copy and prices on screen, card and card-sunk (16:1 light, 13:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Meta lines, secondary copy and labels on screen, card and card-sunk (at least 4.9:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only: dividers dots, disabled icons, empty seat outlines. Never for text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one hot colour: selection, progress, the calendar range, the check, dial ticks. Put ink text on it, not white. The bank's brand can replace this one token.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills behind accent content: inside the calendar range, selected seat halo, money-back chips.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Orange words on card or accent-soft: money back, points earned (5.3:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill, in both themes (6.6:1).

tokens.name: pill
tokens.usage: The black pill: primary buttons, the selected tab, the selected row, the Face ID button. Inverts in dark.

tokens.name: on-pill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a pill fill.

tokens.name: sticky-yellow
tokens.usage: Gratifi's notes: the sticky note, the assistant's moment card. Paper colours live on notes only.

tokens.name: sticky-blue
tokens.usage: Secondary notes: a traveller's own saved note, trip tips.

tokens.name: sticky-ink
tokens.usage: Handwriting and text on sticky-yellow and sticky-blue in both themes (11:1).

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: On time, confirmed, refundable. Always with a word or an icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Background for good badges and banners.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Delayed, few left, price rising. Always with a word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background for warn badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Cancelled, failed, sold out. Always with a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for danger badges and banners.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a sheet or confirm.

families.sans: Geist, "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the screen title.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and sheet titles, the answer's headline.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Departure and arrival times, big prices.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The fare went up by £24 since you picked it.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Grey dot-separated facts under a title.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small uppercase labels above a group: DEPART, GATE, SEAT.

styles.name: hand
styles.usage: Handwriting on sticky notes and polaroid captions only.
styles.sample: Book the hotel on the card too

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Booking references, flight numbers, gate and seat codes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; between meta items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on large cards and sheets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards in a conversation.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Above a screen title.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Seats, calendar days, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, inner wells, stamps' art.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows that sit inside a card, chips' outer shape at 36px height.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Standard card.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, sheets, the phone's inner screen.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the nav bar, segmented controls.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card. Cards never get borders.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating nav, ask bar, sheets, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: Polaroids, stamps, sticky notes: things you can hold.
